safety_constraints: Reject updates lacking I1-I4 compliance metadata
automation_patterns.rollback_strategy: Recompute component_index metadata from last known good snapshot on validation failure

safety_constraints: Run only against ai_docs/*.json referenced in component_index
Block promotion if schema integrity checks fail
automation_patterns.rollback_strategy: Restore previous schema artifacts and re-run validation

safety_constraints: Only orchestrate pytest suites declared in governance status reports
Refuse execution if resolver coverage drops below mandated threshold
automation_patterns.rollback_strategy: Re-run impacted suites with previous commit hash and reconcile ledger entries

safety_constraints: Monitor rolling 5-second averages; act only if utilization stays above 0.27 to avoid oscillation
Throttle or defer tiles rather than terminating them when proofs depend on their outputs
automation_patterns.rollback_strategy: Restore prior resource envelopes and replay proofs with recorded work metrics if throttling caused regressions

safety_constraints: Append run entries only after pytest output logs have been captured by runtime.automation_runner
Reject writes if knowledge_base/automation_runs/index.json fails schema validation
automation_patterns.rollback_strategy: Revert automation_runs/index.json to the previous hash when a run entry is corrupted or duplicated

safety_constraints: Consume only coverage reports generated by runtime.automation_runner
Reject component index writes when schema validation fails
automation_patterns.rollback_strategy: Restore ai_docs/component_index.json to the previous hash if coverage sync introduces invalid metadata

safety_constraints: Write evidence only after benchmarking_runner produces scenario artifacts
Reject ledger updates if automation_runs schema validation fails
automation_patterns.rollback_strategy: Remove the last benchmark entry and regenerate evidence if scenario execution is corrupted
